body: Owner decided 2026-10-08: billing integrations (Stripe, Polar, Autumn, Chargebee, Commet, Creem, Dodo Payments, and the community payment providers) are skipped: payments and entitlements, not authentication; can be added later as separate modules with no core change (plugin-owned tables, after-sign-up hooks, plugin operations). 61 comparison rows moved from ❌ to ➖ in org.md; viewer rebuilt (2617 rows: ✅ 2074, 🟡 26, ❌ 75, ➖ 442).
